title: Per-query Signed Block Interaction Routing
data_reuse: All existing captured raw per-query QKV; no recapture
precision: FP32 historical features/clustering/aggregation,norm-sensitive statistics,signed relations/messages,scores,budget,attention loss; BF16 fusion/ordinary/pre-Q interaction and FFN with FP32 master weights
historical_policy: One shared F/partition/aggregation/one-layer Pre-Q H, equal arm mean pooled attention loss in phase2; frozen and cached once per snapshot in phase1
decoder_policy: Exactly one shared trainable per-query Projection/LayerNorm/log-norm/residual Fusion tensor for all arms. R2/R3 relevance/correction/interaction modules independently train from matching compatible initial tensors.
initialization: Fresh router initialization for each Router seed; no trained v0.4 backbone/router weights. Compatible decoder parameters copied from the R2 template.
objective: Per-update pooled SSE / pooled dense output energy, then mean across arms; separately record tile mean relative error and pooled global error
correction: F_delta([LN(updated_y), LN(mean projected message)-LN(0)]) - F_delta([LN(updated_y),0]); Wm has no effective bias; zero signed message implies exactly zero correction
query_norm_feature: log(norm(q)+epsilon) projected to128 and added after Query Projection LayerNorm; no query mean pooling
relation: Learned centered unit-vector Gram relation, FP32, diagonal/empty masked; absolute-sum normalized signed messages; two blocks, FFN512; negative and abs frozen interventions
pressure_tests: 30% and10% are cross-budget generalization tests, not separately trained budgets

phase1.all_tiles: Without-replacement snapshot sweeps with8-tile rotation;1000 draws over54 snapshots visits every snapshot/tile at least twice

phase2.validation: Fixed36 metadata-balanced Val snapshots, all4steps/8tiles; joint mean Global checkpoint selection; fullVal/Test after selection
phase2.full_training_coverage: At min8000 x4 draws every3456 train snapshot has>=9 visits, covers all8tiles; report selected-checkpoint exposure separately
phase2.convergence: Stop on four validation checks without>=0.2% relative joint improvement after min8000, or max20000. Neither limit proves convergence

phase1_gate: Both seeds finite and all8tile coverage, and at least1% joint validation improvement; failures prevent launching phase2
final_evaluation: All Train/Val/Test snapshots for each selected shared R2/R3 checkpoint, all8tiles/4steps,3 budgets; same-partition per-query Mass and SpatialMass; hard/soft, relevance-only and signed interventions
control_limits: R0 remains historical v0.4 reference with different frontend and normalization, not a clean query-granularity-only ablation
Report parameter counts and signed vs ordinary capacity difference; no performance or video-quality claim
Three Router seeds, not generation seeds, determine mean and sample std
Normalization benefits are monitored but cannot be causally isolated without a separate norm ablation
No selected-set refinement,oracle labels,diffusion loss,backbone training,or auxiliary Mass loss
F/partition/aggregation/Pre-Q H and Q Projection/Fusion are exactly shared; independent branch parameters differ only after matched initialization.
